summary: Full regression + new-feature testing for MAJOR visual upgrade iteration. Backend: expanded pytest suite to 18 tests covering health, 24 zones, 37 roads, heatmap band segments, layers get/toggle/404, analytics zones+peak-hours, system/health (5 sections + p50/p95/p99 latency), signals adjust (200 + 404), full convoy lifecycle (start/pause/resume/status/cancel + idle), emergency route stored + replay corridors listing + detail + 404, live/status seeded fallback, weather seeded, incident lifecycle, assistant stream, and WebSocket {kind:'snapshot', data:{roads,vehicles,heatmap,layers}} envelope. All 18 pass in 6.5s. Frontend: verified all 11 sidebar data-testid nav items render, clicking each routes to the correct URL and renders its data-testid=page-* view. Twin page 3D scene renders; all 8 layer-toggle-* buttons present + clickable; simulation-toggle-button / cinematic-toggle-button / time-of-day-toggle work. AIRA drawer: open, voice-operation-button present, assistant-send-button submits. Emergency dispatch-submit-button appends to history; Convoy start/pause/resume/cancel + convoy-summary all functional; Signals signal-heatmap-grid + signal-optimise-* + signal-duration-slider render; Replay: after emergency creates corridor, replay-row-* rows appear (needs ~2s fetch), replay-play-button/replay-fastforward-button/replay-timeline-slider/replay-frame all work; Incidents log-incident opens modal. Live-feed strip renders 5 SEEDED chips.

integration_issues.issue: replay-row-* not immediately available (~1-2s race). Consider showing a loading skeleton or making the corridor list fetch faster. Non-blocking — rows appear after fetch completes.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: uvicorn hot-reload watches /app/backend so any change to tests file triggers reload storm. Confirmed once during this run (all HTTPS requests timed out until `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`). Recommend narrowing --reload-dir to server modules or moving tests out of backend/.

Replay.jsx: corridorList fetch is fired inside useEffect with dep [corridors]; first paint on hard-nav shows empty state briefly. Consider surfacing a loading state so consumers/testers know data is pending.
Frontend live-feed chips: no data-testid on individual chips (verified text SEEDED but chip elements lack per-feed testids). Nice-to-have for future integration testing.
server.py assistant model 'gpt-5.4' still referenced (fallback works — non-blocking).
